__NOTOC__

Potions of Wonder are wonder-ful things. One will create a single completely random effect when quaffed, sometimes beneficial and sometimes not so much.

== History ==
* In U16.1 Potions of Wonder got an overhaul. In addition to stacking in the inventory, they acquired hundreds of potential effects.

== Sources ==
* Potions of Wonder can be found in chests of all levels at a pretty decent frequency.
* They can also be found in breakables of all levels.
* The above two sources means the Auction House usually has quite a few listed.
* Antiquity collector [[Mela Thryn]] in [[Lordsmarch Plaza]] will trade you 1 Potion of Wonder for 1 [[Oceanic Sphere]].
* Purchase from the [[DDOstore/Seasonal Items#Misc|DDO Store]].

== Observed effects ==
Caster level of these effects is unknown unless noted, but is typically of higher level.

=== Alchemical potions ===
All effects below lasts for 60 seconds and give a +3 [[Alchemical bonus]] to an ability. 
* {{Item|Potion of Prowess|Prowess +3}} (Strength)
* {{Item|Potion of Grace|Grace +3}} (Dexterity)
* {{Item|Potion of Health|Health +3}} (Constitution)
* {{Item|Potion of Knowledge|Knowledge +3}} (Intelligence)
* {{Item|Potion of Reason|Reason +3}} (Wisdom)
* {{Item|Potion of Influence|Influence +3}} (Charisma)

=== Challenge buffs ===
These are the same effects as seen on [[Challenges/Temporary buffs|Challenge]]s. All of them last for 60 seconds. 
* Double Speed
* Hate Magnet 
* Invulnerability
* Quad Damage

=== Healing === 
* [[Cure Critical Wounds]]
* [[Cure Serious Wounds]]
* [[Heal (spell)|Heal]] (HP healing only, no stat damage healing or condition removing, 250 HP)
* [[Greater Restoration]]
* [[Lesser Restoration]] + [[Remove Disease]]
* [[Neutralize Poison]] (but not the immunity buff)
* [[Remove Blindness]]
* [[Remove Curse]]
* [[Remove Disease]] (but not the immunity buff)
* {{Item|Xachosian Larva}}
* [[Mnemonic Enhancer|Greater Mnemonic Enhancer]]
* Major Mnemonic Enhancer
* Superior Mnemonic Enhancer

=== Spells === 
All spells are cast with a [[Caster level]] of 25.
* [[Aid]] (18 Temporary HP only)
* [[Barkskin]] (+5 natural armor)
* [[Energy Drain]] (2d4 negative levels)
* [[Exhaustion]] (No save, 45 seconds)
* [[Greater Heroism]] (No temporary HP)
* [[Haste]] (2:30 duration)
* [[Inflict Critical Wounds]] 
* [[Inflict Serious Wounds]]
* [[Jump]] 
* [[Resist Energy]] (Acid, Fire, Electricity, Cold, or Sonic)
* [[Shield of Faith]] (+5 deflection bonus to AC)
* [[Tumble]]
* [[Water Breathing]] (3:30 duration)

=== Special effects ===
* [[Bees of Xoriat]] (Like the ones used by [[Xy'zzy]])
* Bleeding Wound (15 seconds), as if hit by a [[Werewolf race|werewolf]]
* [[Occult Slayer enhancements|Ear Smash]] (cannot cast spells for two seconds)
* [[Shiradi Champion#Elemental Absorption|Elemental Absorption]] (10% primal bonus to elemental absorption, lasts until you rest)
* [[Energy Drain]]
* Festering Wound (-50 [[Healing Amplification]] for 6 seconds)
* {{Popup|long=yes|[[Font of Power]]|{{:Font of Power}}}} (20 seconds, +400 Spell Power)
* Heavy Gravity (as the effect seen on [[The Dreaming Dark (quest)|Dreaming Dark]])
* [[Humbug]] (25 minutes)
* Prismatic Blindness (3 seconds blindness, no save, as [[Guidance of Shar (enchantment)|Guidance of Shar]]) 
* [[Pumpkin Head]] (13 minutes)
* Stun 12 seconds (that actually last only 4 seconds)<!-- Really, that is the effect name: http://i39.tinypic.com/34fy0c0.jpg -->
* Summon a Droaam Demolition Charge, as seen in [[Undermine]]
* Summon a Rest Shrine
* {{Verified|date=2016-02-20|Summon [[Whirling Blades (Shavarath version)|Whirling Blades]]}} ({{OnYouTube|v=F1mpBdinaKY|t=5s}})
* Summon a {{Item|Tasty Ham}}

...and many others. 

According to {{Forums|p=4850809|this comment by}} {{Developer|Feather_of_Sun}}, Potions of Wonder never confer any type of permanent bonus.
